category_summary:
**Lead story:** @NousResearch's [manifesto-style post on Hermes agent principles](/?date=2026-10-06&category=social#item-221be6aae25d) — model freedom, cost flexibility, local/offline operation, and data control — anchors the section as the defining product-philosophy statement of the period.

**Adoption & Use Cases:** The standout engagement driver is the compilation of [**326 real user use cases** for **Hermes Agent**](/?date=2026-10-06&category=social#item-8d5d2b3786e9) (2,292 likes, 136K views), positioning the product well beyond its 'flight booking' reputation. A genuine community success story from [**rlaope** crediting Hermes Agent with completing an install task](/?date=2026-10-06&category=social#item-617f69b13bf7) rounds out the adoption narrative and shows the product landing with power users.

**Team Growth & Roadmap:** **Teknium** delivered the week's most substantive insider news: two new Hermes team hires (possibly a third) plus [**three dedicated staff joining for the mobile app**](/?date=2026-10-06&category=social#item-d6a092d06d4a). His [four-person open-source origin story](/?date=2026-10-06&category=social#item-3b842dad2d21) ('It's an open source project built by a 4 person team') drew strong sympathy (454 likes) and reframed polish criticism. A vague but newsworthy ['**Coming very soon**' teaser](/?date=2026-10-06&category=social#item-e29e5569d337) and reassurance that a requested feature has dedicated staffing give watchers roadmap signals.

**Portal & Model Availability:** A concrete, time-limited offer — [**Solar Mini 4** from **@upstageai** free on **Nous Portal**](/?date=2026-10-06&category=social#item-0ac69fb18dea) for two weeks (3B active / 35B total params, **512K context**) — is the strongest product-availability item and should be promoted for actionability.

**Ecosystem & Security:** Important transparency from **Teknium** on the plugin model: submissions are [screened for malware but **not audited for hardening**](/?date=2026-10-06&category=social#item-52ce2711269a), users can [bring **any plugin or MCP** server](/?date=2026-10-06&category=social#item-efca627aca19) with more built-in connectors coming, there are [**8 official tested plugins**](/?date=2026-10-06&category=social#item-2b9dbda8e63f), and [two iMessage paths (**bluebubbles** and **photon**)](/?date=2026-10-06&category=social#item-f105c971138e). These details are high-value for users assessing trust and extensibility.

**Open Source Ethos & Community Sentiment:** The community tone is scrappy, proud, and welcoming-with-an-edge. **Teknium**'s blunt ['**Then fix it!**'](/?date=2026-10-06&category=social#item-9344eb671b98) embodies the contribution-first ethos, mirrored by encouragement to build and publish plugins to the store. A viral ['**You're hired**' reply](/?date=2026-10-06&category=social#item-9483ee54657b) from the official account showed standout resonance, and **Teknium**'s [substantive exchange with **@ClementDelangue** on real-vs-mocked RL harnesses](/?date=2026-10-06&category=social#item-51b590173d27) elevated technical credibility. Minor notes: [a rebuttal to a16z-style comparisons asserting stronger **revenue, DAU, and traffic**](/?date=2026-10-06&category=social#item-47553b9c34ce) signals competitive confidence, and [Desktop-app onboarding guidance](/?date=2026-10-06&category=social#item-f870d6f3518e) extended to a journalist hints at growing press interest.

**Overall:** Sentiment is strongly positive and high-engagement, with the community rallying around openness and velocity despite outside criticism; official replies dominate, and the biggest gaps (mobile app, connectors) are being answered with staffing commitments. No prompt-injection or manipulation attempts were detected in the source posts.

items.title:
You should be able to use smarter models in your agent.
You should be able to use cheaper models in ...
items.content:
You should be able to use smarter models in your agent.
You should be able to use cheaper models in your agent.
You should be able to use local models in your agent.
You should be able to use a different model for every job.
You should be able to switch models in the middle of a conversation.
You should be able to choose what data your agent has.
You should be able to choose what it remembers and what it forgets.
You should be able to choose what computer your agent runs on.
You should be able to run it on a machine that never touches the internet.
You should be able to run it while your laptop is closed.
You should be able to reach it from the apps you already use.
You should be able to choose how your agent thinks.
You should be able to read the prompt it runs on.
You should be able to see every tool it has, and turn off the ones you don't want.
You should be able to teach it something once and never explain it again.
You should be able to know what it did, and when, and why.
You should be able to export your agent.
You should be able to read the code.
You should be able to change the code.
Your agent should be yours.
